Brand Introduction

We are a premium beauty brand specializing in the No.1 best-selling eyelash serum, scalp serum, and shampoo in Korea. With a strong presence in the market and overwhelming customer satisfaction, our products have become beauty must-haves. Our commitment to innovation and quality ensures that we deliver highly effective solutions backed by scientific research and dermatological testing.

Product Description

Our No.1 best-selling eyelash serum is a game-changer in lash care. Recognized as the top-ranked eyelash serum at Olive Young, Korea’s largest beauty retailer, this product has undergone clinical testing to prove its efficacy in enhancing lash length, thickness, and strength. Designed for those seeking natural yet dramatic lash growth, this serum is a must-have in any beauty routine.

Unique Selling Points (USP)

  • Patented High-Performance Formula – Infused with biotin, peptides, and other growth-enhancing ingredients, this serum nourishes and strengthens lashes from root to tip, helping to prevent breakage and promote natural growth.
  • Clinically Proven Results – Dermatologist-tested in Korea, this serum has been scientifically validated for its lash-enhancing benefits, ensuring both safety and effectiveness.
  • Larger Capacity for Extended Use – Unlike standard lash serums, which typically come in smaller sizes (3-5ml), our product offers a generous 10ml, providing a longer usage period and better value.
  • Irritation-Free & Safe for Daily Use – Formulated to be gentle on the eyes, making it suitable even for those with sensitive eyes or contact lens users.

Payment Terms

  • Net 30 – Payment due within 30 days of invoice date.

Additional Information

  • Best-Selling & Customer-Favorite – Loved by millions of users in Korea, with a strong reputation for delivering real results.
  • Versatile & Easy to Apply – Designed with a precise applicator for effortless use on eyelashes, eyebrows, and even lower lashes.
  • Expanding Global Reach – Currently available for international distribution, welcoming retail and wholesale partnerships.
